# Corresponding source for Lunr languages 1.14.0

These three unchanged program source files correspond byte-for-byte to the
Lunr languages 1.14.0 npm package. The retained minified files also match that
archive exactly. They are distributed under MPL-1.1, not this project’s MIT
or CC BY 4.0 license. Copyright and authorship notices remain in each file.

- [Full license](../../LICENSES/lunr-languages-MPL-1.1.txt)
- [Upstream package](https://registry.npmjs.org/lunr-languages/-/lunr-languages-1.14.0.tgz)
- [German source](lunr.de.js)
- [Spanish source](lunr.es.js)
- [Shared stemmer support](lunr.stemmer.support.js)

The matching source is published with every website build and retained in Git
history. When retiring a deployment, preserve access to this exact source for
the availability period required by MPL-1.1 section 3.2; do not replace it with
a moving upstream link. No upstream guidance prose is included here.
